::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 3d 1874  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 3-4
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)
I send the two vols of [Bishop Patteson](cmy_books/cmybook_102.qmd) by train today, having done all the abridging that I think they will bear, I believe it is about 100pp in each volume, and a good many lines besides so that with smaller type and thinner paper I think it will be reduced enough.

Since I began this has come the enquiry after the author of the [Children of the Forest or the Three Knights](other_books/otherbook_844.qmd).[^1] I cannot recollect anything about her, nor that the story of that title has been in the Monthly Packet

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: ‘The Children in the Forest’, a translation from the German by C.P., had appeared in *MP* (November 1856), 376-384.
